packageRules.description: Longhorn can only be upgraded one minor version at a time (its pre-upgrade hook rejects skips) and can't be downgraded. Open a separate PR per minor so each can be merged and rolled out in order.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Longhorn upgrades one minor version at a time.** If several Longhorn PRs are open, merge the lowest version first. Before merging the next one, wait until the HelmRelease is `Ready` and every volume shows the new engine (`kubectl -n longhorn-system get volumes.longhorn.io`). Skipping a minor makes the upgrade fail its pre-upgrade check.
